residues.sentence: The agent must first obtain the user id from the user. / The agent should then ask for the trip type, origin, destination.
residues.note: Obligations survive only as two required evidence attestations; 'first'/'then' cannot be expressed (rules carry no order, evidence records only presence).

residues.sentence: The agent needs to collect the first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger.
residues.note: Collapsed to one attestation proxy: the pack cannot check three fields, per passenger, over a list.

residues.sentence: The remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable.
residues.note: Downstream monetary consequence of the booking; the format has no vocabulary for post-decision effects, so nothing reads it. Not a condition on the booking.

residues.sentence: If the booking user is a regular member: 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger … 4 free checked bags for each business passenger.
residues.note: Direction loss: all nine rows are encoded, but the format can only test a proposed allowance against a literal, never emit one. The 'for each … passenger' scaling also leaves the pack (into the computed extraCheckedBags).

residues.sentence: The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.
residues.note: Second clause is a future cross-decision entitlement (Cancel flight); no representation at all. Only the unit price is encoded.

residues.sentence: The agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance.
residues.note: Speech-act duty plus deontic modality: encoded as a required attestation, which upgrades 'should' into a hard precondition that can make a compliant booking unresolved.

facts.note: Applicability-only scope token.
Stored reservation field; the policy guarantees one reservation-level value, so no aggregation.
Requires reading two segment collections, deciding which segment defines the trip origin, and comparing; no iteration and no pointer-to-pointer comparison in the format.
Same two-collection comparison, plus a policy reading (for a round trip 'destination' must mean the turnaround, not the final arrival airport).
Proposed itinerary has no stored trip type; it must be classified from the proposed segment list and compared with the stored value.

residues.sentence: Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices will not be updated based on the current price.
residues.note: The pricing half has no representation in the machinery — outcomes carry no monetary payload; it survives only as rationale text on permit-shape-preserving-change.

residues.sentence: The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!
residues.note: 'Before calling the API' orders an external action; §6.4 forbids outcomes from authorizing actions. Only approximated by a required attestation plus onUnknown: escalate.

facts.note: Applicability-only scope token.
Read directly off what the user asked; no reservation data needed.
Set equality between the segments the user named and the reservation's full segment list.

Records carry available/delayed/on time/flying, never 'flown'; someone must place each segment in the flight lifecycle and decide which states count. Also quantifies over segments; in this room the reading is 'has taken off' (A6 reads it as 'has landed' — same construct, divergent upstream definitions).
Price the whole reservation in the new cabin (sum over segments and passengers) and compare with the recorded original; the format has no pointer-to-pointer ordering and no portable decimal ordering.

residues.sentence: In other cases, all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.
residues.note: The bare permission cannot be stated: every allow outcome bundles a money consequence, so a missing price direction yields unresolved on a change the policy plainly permits. 'Including basic economy' is encoded only by the absence of a condition — nothing a validator could check.

residues.sentence: Cabin class must remain the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.
residues.note: Second clause encoded; the uniformity invariant itself is checked nowhere — the pack never reads any cabin class, so a request naming business outbound and economy return covers all segments and passes.

residues.sentence: If the price after cabin change is higher than the original price, the user is required to pay for the difference. / If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price, the user is should be refunded the difference.
residues.note: Directions encoded as outcomes; the amount ('the difference') is nowhere in the pack — outcomes are labels and cannot carry a computed decimal. Policy silence on equal prices is filled by an invented outcome (a gap, not residue).

facts.note: Applicability scope; carries the 'after initial booking' qualifier structurally.
Applicability/guard token for which limb of the section applies.

Requires comparing requested end-state counts against recorded counts (pointer-to-pointer comparison the format lacks), and settling two questions the policy leaves open: per-passenger vs reservation-wide measurement, and how a mixed add+remove request classifies.

Classifies a requested transition of the reservation's recorded insurance state (has → wants), including whether asking for insurance already held counts as 'add'. Two record/request states must be compared outside the pack.
Applicability-only scope token.
Applicability-only scope token.
Build the post-change roster from free-text, count both rosters and compare; also settles whether substitution or an add-plus-remove nets to a count change — a policy call the sentence delegates.

residues.sentence: Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.
residues.note: No construct for terminality or for forbidding escalation: escalation is a trigger list keyed to reason codes and an outcome generates no reason, so the bar exists only by construction and in prose.

facts.note: Same construct as A3's anyFlightFlown: place each segment in the lifecycle and decide what 'flown' denotes against a status vocabulary that lacks the term; here it also needs scheduled-arrival vs current time and a disjunction over segments.

Elapsed hours between the stored created time and 'now'. More than unit conversion: the format has no clock and no duration arithmetic, so half of 'within the last 24 hrs' is discharged upstream (only the literal 24 stays in the pack).
Disjunction over all segments of a per-segment record; mechanical but not expressible in the format.

The only coverage definition in the policy (health/weather, from Book flight) does not line up with the three reason categories Cancel flight collects, so someone must judge whether a narrative reason falls inside coverage.

residues.sentence: If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.
residues.note: Procedural instruction about how to obtain an input; no tool/procedure vocabulary. Survives only in an evidence requirement's description.

residues.sentence: The user must provide their user id.
residues.note: Provenance constraint: evidence requirements are a bare tri-state with no authenticity or source model, so an agent-inferred id satisfies the same 'present'.

residues.sentence: The agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)
residues.note: Obligation carried by an attestation, but the three-way enumeration is enforced nowhere; the category enters the decision only through the insurance-coverage determination.

residues.sentence: The API does not check that cancellation rules are met, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!
residues.note: Ordering of an external action; approximated by onUnknown: escalate on the closure rule.

residues.sentence: The refund will go to original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.
residues.note: Post-decision effect and service timing; no effect vocabulary, so it lives only in the permitted outcome's description.

residues.sentence: First, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id.
residues.note: The obligations are two required evidence requirements; 'First' — collection before anything else — has no representation.

Cardinality of the stored passenger list — aggregation over a collection, same construct as A1's passengerCount, even though no interpretation is involved.

residues.sentence: Always confirms the facts before offering compensation.
residues.note: 'Before' cannot be expressed — the pack can only see an attestation at evaluation time; and 'always' is weakened because the requirement is declared required:false so refusals can resolve unconfirmed.

residues.sentence: the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture (both grant sentences)
residues.note: Deontic modality: outcomes are declared results with no third value between permitted and refused, so residual agent discretion to decline a permitted gesture is unrepresentable; the outcome labels ('Offer travel certificate …') overstate the modality.

residues.sentence: with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers / with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers
residues.note: Override of the encoder, who scored this as fully preserved. The multiplication is executed nowhere in the pack: the multiplier survives only in prose and a non-normative extension, and the passenger count is read merely as an availability gate.

residues.sentence: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
residues.note: Gate encoded; 'before taking the action' cannot be observed — pushed onto an attestation plus onUnknown: escalate.

residues.sentence: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled', and the total will be refunded via the original payment method immediately if it is gift card, otherwise in 5 to 7 business days.
residues.note: The gift-card branch survives as two outcome identities, but the state transition, the refund issuance and the timing are post-action effects with no field in the format.

Requires selecting the original charge from the order's payment history and an identity comparison between two ids — neither list selection nor pointer-to-pointer comparison exists in the format.
balance ≥ order total, two runtime values; the format compares a pointer to a literal only and assigns no portable decimal ordering. Also fixes 'cover' as inclusive.

residues.sentence: An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
residues.note: Gate encoded; the lookup-before-acting directive is only approximated by escalate-on-unknown.

residues.sentence: For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
residues.note: Closed-world scope claim: a single-question pack cannot assert the closure. Out-of-enumeration requests return not-applicable — silence, not the denial the sentence wants.

residues.sentence: After user confirmation, the order status will be kept as 'pending'.
residues.note: Confirmation modelled as a non-blocking attestation used in no condition; the post-action state statement has no field and lives in outcome prose.

residues.sentence: The original payment method will be refunded immediately if it is a gift card, otherwise it will be refunded within 5 to 7 business days.
residues.note: Pure post-action effect that gates nothing; carried only in the permitted outcome's description — the pack never reads the original method's type.

Two catalog lookups per pair plus a conjunction over the whole substitution list; also fixes 'same product' as same product id.
Pairwise option-map inequality conjoined over the list; must also commit to what 'different product option' means.
Per-item availability is a plain lookup, but the pack reads one aggregate boolean, so the conjunction is discharged upstream.
The customer's own confirmation that the list is complete.

Price out both baskets, subtract, compare against balance; also decides that a non-positive difference imposes no balance requirement.

residues.sentence: This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'.
residues.note: Once-only limit encoded via the status value; the post-action state transition has no representation (outcomes are results, not mutations).

residues.sentence: The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore.
residues.note: A claim about the agent's future capability, half of it about a different decision (cancel); carried only as rationale and a source excerpt.

residues.sentence: So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action.
residues.note: Open-ended diligence duty with no enumerable condition; 'be cautious' has no truth value. Approximated by a strong conjunction plus onUnknown: escalate.

residues.sentence: In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.
residues.note: Speech-act duty on the agent: the pack captures the customer's confirmation but nothing about issuing the reminder; §6.1 forbids embedding prompts.

residues.sentence: The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference.
residues.note: Provision of a method is encoded as evidence; the 'to pay or receive refund' direction is not — the pack never models the price difference or its sign.

residues.sentence: There is no need to place a new order.
